players.product: mature-node logic / DRAM foundry; 3D AI Foundry silicon interposers, wafer-on-wafer (WoW) DRAM stacking; HBM post-wafer-fab (PWF) foundry services

quarterly_data.signal: PSMC 3Q26 results (deck, unreviewed): operating revenue NT$21,342 million (US$666.31 million), +23% QoQ (by USD +22%) and +80% YoY, with ASP up 24%; gross profit NT$10,148 million, gross margin 48% (2Q26: 28%), on ASP improvement, the Tonglo fab ceasing to run and higher utilization; income from operations NT$7,830 million; net income NT$6,500 million (30% net margin; 2Q26 NT$3,291 million), partly offset by income tax and tool-relocation expense; EPS NT$1.38. Nine months 2026: operating revenue NT$52,205 million (+52% YoY) and net income NT$24,022 million versus a loss of NT$7,159 million. Cash and cash equivalents NT$40,935 million at September 30.
quarterly_data.figure: 3Q26 revenue NT$21,342 million (+80% YoY); gross margin 48%

quarterly_data.signal: PSMC foundry segment 3Q26 (deck): utilization 97% (2Q26: 87%; 3Q25: 78%) and idle-capacity loss NT$171 million (2Q26: NT$1,656 million); wafer shipments 416 thousand 12-inch wafer equivalents (-1% QoQ, -5% YoY). Logic foundry: all wafer foundries are fully loaded in 2026, capacity is insufficient, and automotive TDDI still faces capacity shortages and extended delivery times; interposer lines moved from Tonglo to Hsinchu with temporary disruption, expected back to full capacity by the end of the year.

PSMC outlook (deck): Q4 company-wide revenue is still expected to grow by double digits, and revenue and profits are both promising in 2027; the 2026 capex budget is about US$0.413 billion. In logic foundry, 8-inch and 12-inch wafer-start ASPs rose 8~10% in Q3, and a further price increase of 10~20% is expected in 2027, with price and volume linked to long-term agreements; memory-foundry finished-product ASPs are still 30% or more below wafer-start ASPs. The new fab plan focuses on 3D AI foundry, with new capacity to be jointly invested with strategic customers.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 capex budget about US$0.413 billion; 2027 logic price increase 10~20% expected

quarterly_data.signal: PSMC long-term agreements (deck): 80% of its MOSFET / IGBT capacity is secured with long-term agreements (LTAs) for 2027; 55nm BCD production for power-management ICs (AI server and automotive demand) has begun, with customers requiring three-year contracts to ensure supply.

PSMC 3D AI foundry roadmap (deck): CoWoS order overflow drives strong interposer demand; the wafer-on-wafer (WoW) line, moved from Tonglo to Hsinchu, has resumed production in risk run with mass production officially from the first half of 2027; PWF work with Micron targets pilot-line completion by the end of 2026 and mass production in Q4 2027; IPD visibility now extends to 2028, 8-inch and 12-inch IPDs (1.2V~100V, 10nf~2300nf) are in mass production and a 4500nf product comes next year. 3D AI foundry revenue will increase quarter by quarter from 2027, with PWF added in 2028. In memory foundry, DRAM 1P process PDK completes before year-end with pilot production scheduled for Q2 2027.

PSMC memory foundry views (deck): inference is replacing training as the main consumer of compute, creating a seemingly 'bottomless pit' of DRAM demand; DDR3 spot prices weakened short term on abundant supply from disassembled boards, while niche DRAM wafer-start prices remain high. With MLC NAND short, demand for large-capacity SLC should rise and PSMC moved its SLC foundry platform to 24nm, with new MLC NAND products expected by the end of 2026; AI servers drive a 3-5 times increase in NOR Flash content per box versus traditional servers, and PSMC says it is the only foundry for NOR Flash products outside China.
quarterly_data.figure: NOR Flash content per AI server box 3-5 times traditional servers

contracts.signal: PSMC deck: PSMC continues to work closely with Micron on post-wafer-fab (PWF) services, expecting to complete the pilot line by the end of 2026 and to begin mass production in Q4 2027.
contracts.units: pilot line by end-2026; mass production Q4 2027
